hero.title: A clear read of your skin, and products chosen by their ingredients.
hero.lede: One selfie in daylight. Thirteen readings with their confidence, a routine built from what each ingredient has been shown to do, and a verdict on any product you hold up to the camera.
hero.imageAlt: A young woman taking a selfie in daylight with a lavender phone.

texture.name: Glycolic 7 % exfoliating toner
texture.direction: Evenings, after cleansing. Start twice a week.

photodamage.name: Daily defence SPF 50 fluid
photodamage.needs: Your skin needs SPF 30 or more, every morning.
photodamage.direction: Mornings, last step. Two finger-lengths for the face.

darkCircles.name: Caffeine eye serum
darkCircles.direction: Mornings, a grain of rice under each eye.

readings.title: Thirteen readings, with how much to trust each
readings.text: Every concern is scored 0 to 100, three times. You see the score, the overlay on your own face, and whether the readings agree.

routine.title: A routine that shows its working
routine.text: Each product arrives as a dispensing label: how much of an active it holds, against what your skin needs, and when to use it.

check.title: Any product, checked against your skin
check.text: Scan a barcode or photograph the ingredient list. You get fits, neutral or caution, with the reasons and any conflict with what you already own.
check.verdictText: Azelaic acid at a useful dose. No fragrance. No conflict with your shelf.

independence.title: Ranked by ingredients and evidence. Never by brand.
independence.text: A retailer's catalogue only tells us what is in stock. Ranking is never for sale. If a sponsored slot ever exists, it will be labelled, and it will never change the order.

retailers.title: The same read, inside your store
retailers.text: On your product pages, on an in-store tablet, or through the API. Your catalogue marks what is in stock. The ranking stays independent.
retailers.pilot: A pilot runs six to eight weeks with the fee waived, an A/B test on your product pages and a public case study.

close.title: Your skin, read in daylight.
close.text: Leave your e-mail and we will send a sign-in link when your turn comes.

HowItWorksPage.title: How it works
HowItWorksPage.lede: The journey as the app runs it, from the first selfie to a product you can trust.

consent.title: Consent first
consent.text: You confirm you are over 18 and choose how long your photo is kept: 30 days, or deleted the moment it is scored.

selfie.title: A selfie in daylight
selfie.text: A quality gate checks light, pose and focus before anything is analysed. About 30 seconds.

questions.title: A few questions
questions.text: Skin type, sensitivities, pregnancy, allergies and what you already use.

readings.title: Thirteen readings
readings.text: Each concern scored 0 to 100, three times, with how far the readings agree and an overlay on your own face.

routine.title: A routine by evidence
routine.text: Day, night and weekly steps chosen from graded ingredient evidence, with how much of each active you need.

check.title: Any product, checked
check.text: Barcode or label photo. Fits, neutral or caution, with reasons and conflicts against what you own.
check.verdictText: Denatured alcohol high on the list. Your skin reads sensitive.

progress.title: Progress over scans
progress.text: Repeat in 4 to 12 weeks. Changes are shown with measurement noise taken out.

safety.title: Cosmetic guidance, not a medical diagnosis.
safety.referral: A blemish reading of 70 or more suggests seeing a dermatologist, and the app says so.
safety.where: Photos are stored in Frankfurt and read by Google Gemini and by our image models in London.
safety.delete: You can delete your photos, or your whole account, at any time.
safety.sarah: Sarah, the in-app assistant, says she is an AI and only answers from your own analysis, routine and ingredient notes.

RetailersPage.title: The same read, inside your store.
RetailersPage.lede: Shoppers see their skin, a routine and products that fit, on your product pages or in your store. Your catalogue says what is in stock. The ranking stays independent.

widget.title: Widget on a product page
widget.text: One script tag. A shopper scans, and the page shows whether this product fits their skin, with the reasons.

store.title: In-store tablet
store.text: The same read at the counter, with recommendations from your shelves first and a printed or e-mailed routine.

api.title: API
api.text: Sessions, scans, routines and product verdicts over HTTPS, with your own catalogue imported as an availability overlay.

rank.title: Rank first, then stock.
rank.text: Every shopper is ranked over the whole catalogue. Your catalogue only marks what is in stock, with your price and your link, and names the best in-stock option when a top pick is missing.

s1.title: Attract
s1.text: A skin read on the product page draws people in and keeps them there.

s2.title: Identify
s2.text: One session links the read to the shopper, with their consent.

s3.title: Recommend
s3.text: Products that fit their skin, from your shelves first.

s4.title: Retain
s4.text: Follow-up scans bring them back in 4 to 12 weeks.

s5.title: Learn
s5.text: Anonymised, aggregate insights with explicit opt-in. Never individual records.

pilot.title: A pilot, not a pitch.
pilot.text: Six to eight weeks. The platform fee is waived. We run an A/B test on your product pages and publish a case study at the end.
